entities.name: Suzuki coupling of aryl trifluoroborate
observations: The potassium aryltrifluoroborate is intended to couple with a haloquinoline under phosphine/base conditions.
For otherwise comparable aryl halides, oxidative addition generally follows I > Br > Cl, making the iodide the most reactive candidate.

entities.name: Ic1ccc2ncccc2c1
observations: Aryl iodide candidate; expected to be the most reactive electrophile for Suzuki-Miyaura coupling among the listed halides.

entities.name: Brc1ccc2ncccc2c1
observations: Aryl bromide candidate; typically less reactive than the corresponding iodide but more reactive than chloride in oxidative addition.

entities.name: Clc1ccc2ncccc2c1
observations: Aryl chloride candidate; generally the least reactive option under comparable Suzuki conditions.
